summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, announcing it received construction permits for the Santo Niño and Navidad portals at its Santa Elena mine in Mexico. The company reports infill drilling results and plans a $12 million investment in 2026 to advance underground access. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; it is a routine operational update on permitting and exploration progress.
